records.rationale: Retain the separate 32-bit ASHMEM_GET_FILE_ID ioctl encoding, compat_ptr conversion and exactly-u32 output for both real ashmem and memfd compatibility, plus ENOTTY for unknown memfd ioctls. The bionic UAPI uses unsigned long, whose ioctl size differs across 32/64-bit applications; local libcutils AshmemCompatFileIDTest compares its unsigned-long result with fstat. SDK enables IA32/COMPAT. Truncating the inode to the compat width follows this existing ABI; it does not promise globally unique 64-bit IDs to 32-bit clients. UserSliceWriter retains bounded usercopy/fault behavior; per-file locking protects real-ashmem backing lookup. No actual 32-bit userspace program was executed.
